blb.text: Zoraline, a batfolk cleric, volunteers along with Finneas, Hugs, Gev and Helga to accompany Mabel to Pondside, after leaving Three Tree City with only a note and resting in Goodhill.
The party fights necromancers' skeletons and follows the necromancers toward Three Tree City, where a great wave sweeps them into the Long River and Hugs keeps everyone afloat.
Zoraline sneezes awake and the dragon-hawk dives at the party, but Finneas shoots an arrow, Zoraline disorients the creature, and Ral channels a storm of lightning into it.
In Fountainport a battle breaks out in the throne room with the Direshades, where Zoraline's magic obscures her movements, and the returning heroes are welcomed with a parade in Goodhill.
